newsitem.title: UK: Saudi leaves most crudes to Europe unchanged in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Saudi leaves most crudes to Europe unchanged in Feb.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has left the price of most of its crudes sold to Europe unchanged in February, trade sources said on Thursday.
Saudi Arabian light crude will cost $1.85 a barrel less than dated Brent, Saudi Arabian Heavy $3.60 less than Brent and Berri Extra light $1.00 less than Brent, all for February loading.
No price was immediately available for Arab Medium.
But Saudi crude prices to the United States were mostly cut.

Saudi Arabian Light will cost $3.05 a barrel below West Texas Intermediate (WTI) in February compared to $2.80 below in January. Heavy will cost $4.65 under WTI compared to $4.25 under in January and Berri Extra Light will cost $2.05 under compared to $1.90 below in January.
As with European prices, no level was immediately available for Arab Medium to the United States in February.
All prices are fob basis Ras Tanura.
